name: Merokia
description: Merokia was a desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories near the Unknown Regions, in grid square J-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was inhabited during the era of the New Republic. Merokia was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin.
lead_paragraphs: Merokia was a desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories near the Unknown Regions, in grid square J-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was inhabited during the era of the New Republic. Merokia was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin.
During the High Republic Era Merokia was allied to E'ronoh but cut ties after the Eiram and E'ronoh War reignited again.
